title: The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication
synopsis: Softstar’s sequel to The Bridge Curse — retained as PQube’s Nintendo Switch game card.

catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · retail edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication returns to Softstar Entertainment’s haunted university, following a new group of students drawn into the legend of the ghost bride.

It released on PC on May 9, 2024, and on Nintendo Switch on October 24, 2024, with PQube handling the physical release in North America and Europe.

The filing follows Road to Salvation in The Bridge Curse lineage.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is PQube’s retail edition of The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication on a Nintendo Switch game card.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: PC release May 9, 2024; Nintendo Switch release October 24, 2024 (HAC-P-BKP3A).
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by PQube, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
